route_facts.fact: The canonical destination address in Guest Resources is 37691 Breaker Reach, Sea Ranch, CA 95497.
Guest Resources links a Google Map for Vista Del Mar.

At mile marker SOM 54.41 on Highway 1, turn left onto Vantage Road, then left on Breaker Reach, continue to the end of the cul-de-sac, and the home is the first home on the right side of the cul-de-sac.
Before departure, Guest Resources says to check for delays or detours.
CHP Traffic Incident Information is described as the most up-to-the-minute source for roads patrolled by CHP, including incidents such as a tree across Highway 1 at Sea Ranch.
Caltrans/DOT Road Information is described as the definitive source for medium- and long-term status information for numbered California highways such as US 101 and CA 1.
Sonoma County Road Closures and Delays is described as the source for unnumbered roads in Sonoma County, for example River Road flooding.

Guest Resources says a complete picture generally requires checking the CHP site and either the DOT and/or Sonoma County site as appropriate, and that Google Maps is often up-to-date for closed roads.
Because cell phones can be iffy in mobile dead spots or weak-network areas, Guest Resources encourages guests to print and carry the directions.
Checking Out tells guests to check route delays, detours, and road closures while they still have internet access.

realtime_deference.required_deference: Sally must not provide live or turn-by-turn navigation. It should hand off to Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze, or another live navigation provider for real-time routing to 37691 Breaker Reach.

Sally must not claim current road closure, road closures, delays, or detours. It should direct guests to CHP for up-to-the-minute incidents, Caltrans/DOT for numbered highways including CA 1 and US 101, and Sonoma County for local unnumbered roads.

Sally must not provide a weather forecast or infer current travel safety from static Guest Resources. For severe weather, storms, power outages, mudslides, or trees blocking roadways, it should defer to current weather, utility, public-agency, and road authorities; Sally is not a weather service.

For evacuation, wildfire, tsunami, earthquake, medical, police, or immediate emergency guidance, Sally should tell guests to call 911 when immediate, follow public authorities and local emergency instructions, and use Survival Guide contacts such as Sea Ranch Fire Department, Sonoma County Sheriff, CHP, The Sea Ranch Association emergency resources, and KGUA.
